title: Data not getting through LibreLink patched app to xDrip+
body:
Hello, i am having a strange problem.
I just activated a new sensor 21:00 ish yesterday, now it's 01:50.
And Xdrip+ refuses to collect any information at all from the LibreLink Patched2 app.

I have an OnePlus 8 Pro Android 11 phone.

I updated xDrip+ today also before I put on a new sensor.
Not sure if that can cause it.
Current version: versjon e89e23d-2021.01.29
One of the older versions, not sure if this was one of the versions I updated to, today.
versjon 39d5184-2019.12.05
This is the version I had before I got into trouble, but downgrading to that version does not help either:
![Screenshot_20210131-015859](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4199669/106371755-85f35f00-6368-11eb-8633-4580cc8c4357.jpg)
